controls.reason: Completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and control effectiveness are not given a bounded audit protocol, authoritative inventory, or approved thresholds, and effectiveness still requires contextual judgment.

Support status and configuration traceability can be compared for a declared complete inventory, but proving that no unknown critical asset exists and judging whether a high-impact tool is qualified are not bounded by this rule.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every technology in the complete declared production inventory has an authoritative lifecycle status that is allowed by the approved support policy.
Every item in the complete declared production-configuration inventory is joined to its required authenticated traceability record.
